{{Quote|Our problem is simple&mdash;the Separatist navy has four times the number of ships we do. We must slow down their ship production or this war will end quickly, and not in our favor.|Mace Windu|<ref name="SOD">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref>}}
The '''Confederate Navy''', also known as the '''Separatist navy''' or '''Separatist fleet''', was a large collection of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and other [[Starship/Legends|starships]] provided for the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatists' armed forces]] by the contributing members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Abregado.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Malevolence'' served as a flagship for General Grievous, destroying many Republic warships.]]
The navy was organized around [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] of [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] built by hundreds of aggressively independent star systems, who often donated them to the various commercial organizations frontlining the war. The main [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] were donated by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

During the early days of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], the fledgling Confederate Navy was complemented by [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]], pledged to the Separatist cause by [[Cavik Toth]] just prior to the Clone Wars. Toth led his squadron during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="SF">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>

Although the ships were often commanded by droid officers, many fleets and blockades were placed under the command of organic [[Captain/Legends|Captains]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]]. While Dooku's most trusted [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]], such as [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], retained leadership positions even within the Navy, Admirals like [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]], [[Kirst (admiral)|Kirst]], and [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] were responsible for leading entire fleets and were important tacticians during the war. Trench in particular was a feared admiral whose tactics tore apart Republic fleets. The famed Admiral was presumed to have perished during the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]] prior to the Clone Wars but had survived the battle and joined the Separatist Alliance at the outset of the Clone Wars. Trench was defeated and again believed to have been killed during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] in the second year of the Clone Wars.<ref name="CAM">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref> Trench actually survived the battle thanks to [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] which were used to replace much of the left side of his body. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Calli Trilm]] &mdash; a close confidante of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] &mdash; served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Clysm Fleet]] until her capture at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="DVGP4">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 4]]</ref>

At the beginning of the war, the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] used its deadly [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to great effect, terrorizing Republic supply lines and making short work of multiple naval task forces, such as [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] fleet whilst stationed in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]].<ref name="RM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The ship was destroyed by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team, who reprogrammed the ship to collide with the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]].<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The separatists did not give up on the ''Malevolence'', however, and it was succeeded by its sister ship, the ''[[Devastation]]'', which Dooku placed under the command of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Sai Sircu]].<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref> Grievous later attempted to rebuild his fallen flagship, dubbed the [[Malevolence (II)|''Malevolence II'']].<ref name="CC">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref>

[[File:Star_wars_kinect_cis_ships.png|thumb|220x220px|Separatist ships during the [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant]]]]
The navy depended on large shipyards administered by [[Overseer/Legends|Overseers]] who watched over the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] whom they depended on to build the massive warships quickly. They made use of organic workers rather than droids so that the Republic could not bomb their shipyards without immense civilian casualties. In an effort to halt production, a team consisting of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] infiltrated the [[Gwori shipyards]] and liberated the facility's slaves, allowing a strike team to bomb the shipyards. The destruction of the shipyard tipped the balance of the war away from the Separatists, allowing the Clone Wars to rage on.<ref name="SOD" />

During the course of the war, Separatist warships participated in various engagements, notably during the [[Sky Battle of Quell|Quell]],<ref name="JC">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref> [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="ARC">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> and [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Umbara]].<ref name="PoD">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref> Other times, such at [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> [[Lola Sayu defense fleet/Legends|Lola Sayu]],<ref name="Citadel">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> and [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]],<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref> Confederate ships served defensive purposes or blockades.

[[File:CIS_Landing_on_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|230px|Separatists landing on Coruscant|left]]
One of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], led the navy on a [[Operation Durge's Lance|hit-and-fade campaign]] that disrupted travel, communication, and commerce in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] regions, as well as mass invasions on vulnerable Outer Rim worlds.

Towards the end of the war, while millions of Separatist warships battled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in vast [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim campaigns]], a task force led personally by General Grievous and amounting to several thousand ships made a fast snatch at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an attempt to capture [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> This task force was defeated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], and its remnants retreated into hyperspace.

==Aftermath==
At the end of the war, the Confederacy still had many more armadas of ships in its holdings in the Outer Rim Territories, but these were made redundant after [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|the deactivation]] of most of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

[[11 BBY/Legends|Years later]], some remaining ships appeared in [[Gizor Dellso's navy|Gizor Dellso's Remnant Navy]], a [[Fleet/Legends|starfleet]] created by [[Gizor Dellso]] for his [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. This fleet was destroyed in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|conquest]] of the volcanic world.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

==Organization==
Throughout its existence, the Confederate Navy was composed of six levels to its command structures.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The structure was as follows:

===Section===
The '''[[section]]''' was the smallest group in the Separatist admiralty. It was commanded by a captain and was composed of two to four vessels, as well as maintenance and support crews.<ref name="EGW" />

===Flight===
The '''flight''' was composed of two to four sections, and by extension, four to 16 vessels. It was commanded by a [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]].<ref name="EGW" />

===Squadron===
The '''squadron''' was made up of three or four flights, and by extension, 12 to 64 vessels. It was commanded by a commodore.<ref name="EGW" />

===Task group===
The '''[[task group]]''' was composed of three to 10 squadrons, comprising 36 to 640 vessels. It was commanded by a [[Rear Admiral/Legends|rear admiral]].<ref name="EGW" />

===Task force===
The '''task force''' was composed of two task groups, with 72 to 1,280 vessels for each task force. It was commanded by a [[Vice Admiral/Legends|vice admiral]].<ref name="EGW" />

===Fleet===
The highest of the levels, the '''fleet''', was composed of three task forces, and 200 to 4,000 vessels among them. It was commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. The Confederate Navy comprised at least a hundred fleets.<ref name="EGW" />
